snippet.title: 올리브오일에 오브제를 입힌 브랜드 🫒🎨🇮🇹
snippet.description:
테누타 산틸라리오는 이탈리아 와인 생산지로 유명한 아브루쪼에서 온 130년 헤리티지 올리브 오일 브랜드인데요. 신세계 백화점 강남에서 전제품을 직접 눈으로 볼 수 있고, 무료 시음에 럭키드로우 행사까지 참여할 수 있는 팝업이 열리고 있어요 

제가 올리브오일 러버인데, 이렇게 다양하고 감각적인 브랜드는 처음! 테누타 산틸라리오의 가장 큰 특징은 ’신선함‘! 올리브 재배부터 수확, 압착, 병입까지 전 과정을 자체 농장에서 직접 관리하고, 수확한 올리브는 24시간 이내로 냉압착해서 추출하는데요. 엑스트라버진 올리브오일의 기준 산도인 0.8% 보다 훨씬 낮은 0.33%라 폴리페놀도 높고, 항산화 효과도 높은 친구랍니다 

와인 좋아하시는 분들이라면 이탈리아 와인 명산지 아브루쪼 다들 한번씩 들어보셨죠? 유럽에서도 손꼽히는 청정지역이라 올리브도 맛있고, 단일 품종 뿐만 아니라 여러 올리브 품종을 블렌딩해서 쌉쌀함, 매콤함, 허브향까지 고루 갖춘 하이 밸런스 올리브 오일이랍니다.

신세계 강남점 팝업은 4월 30일까지로 무료 시음, 다양한 제품 비교와 구매 금액에 따른 증정 이벤트도 있어서 꼭 가보시길 바랄게요 💚

id.title: Ini bukan bebek Peking.
id.description:
Ini bukan Bebek Peking.

'Bebek Seoul,' yang dikembangkan oleh Chef Kim Do-yoon sebagai hidangan yang sangat cocok dipadukan dengan alkohol sekaligus meningkatkan cita rasa Myeonseoul.

Bebek-bebek tersebut dipelihara di Bonghwa selama 45 hari, dimatangkan selama 10 hari menggunakan resep rahasia Chef Kim Do-yoon, dan kemudian dipanggang. Sejak pertama kali muncul, kilau yang memukau, ukuran yang tebal, dan saus Jukjangyeon sungguh luar biasa; saya memakannya dengan lahap.

Kulit yang renyah, tekstur yang lembut, rasa daging yang kaya, dan rasa umami melebihi ekspektasi saya. Masakan seorang master chef berada di level yang berbeda.

Sama seperti Bebek Peking yang telah menjadi hidangan khas Tiongkok, saya menantikan masa depan Bebek Seoul ♥️

@myeonseoul 
@projectsyun 

#Myeonseoul #ChefKimDoyoon #SeoulDuck

#BlackAndWhiteChef #SeoulDuck

en-US.title: This is not Peking duck.
en-US.description:
This is not Peking Duck.

‘Seoul Duck,’ developed by Chef Kim Do-yoon as a dish that pairs perfectly with alcohol while upgrading Myeonseoul.

The ducks were raised in Bonghwa for 45 days, aged for 10 days using Chef Kim Do-yoon’s secret recipe, and then roasted. From the moment they appeared, the dazzling sheen, the thick size, and the Jukjangyeon sauce were simply amazing; I ate it like crazy.

The crispy skin, the tender texture, the rich meaty flavor, and the umami taste exceeded my expectations. A master chef’s cuisine is on a whole different level.

Just as Peking Duck has become a representative Chinese dish, I look forward to the future of Seoul Duck♥️

en-US.description:
For Children's Day dining out, nothing beats marinated short ribs! 😋🤟

Seoul Ansim Meat in Magok is located inside a hotel, so it is pleasant and parking is convenient. The price is in the 30,000-40,000 won range, which is just right!! The side dishes are exquisite, so even though I'm paying for it, I feel like I'm being treated like royalty, hehehe.

✔ Premium Hanwoo aged for 504 hours

✔ Grilling service where staff grill the meat for you

✔ Clean high chairs and children's tableware provided

✔ Corkage-free when booking via Naver

✔ Spacious parking lot and a 10% discount for hotel guests

If you haven't decided where to go for Children's Day yet, this is the place for lunch! Seoul Ansim Meat Shop is located in Yeouido, Jonggak, and Magok 🔥🔥

en-US.title: Not Pyongyang Naengmyeon, but Piyang Naengmyeon
en-US.description:
Piyangok really lived up to its reputation...👀🔥🔥

Piyangok, the long-standing Pyongyang Naengmyeon (cold noodle) restaurant in Apgujeong.

I visited because I heard the ‘Piyang Naengmyeon,’ released for this summer, was incredibly delicious.

Wow... the clean umami flavor from the added soy sauce is a work of art.

It’s the first time I haven’t been able to finish the noodles because I was drinking the broth.

That just goes to show how generous the portion is, lol. Wow...

Quite a few people compare it to the Uraeok style, but at 15,000 won, it’s much more affordable, and since it tastes great, I’m a winner for Piyangok!

The bulgogi is still delicious, and since it’s a restaurant with no bottle limit and a 5,000 won corkage fee per person,

it will be remembered as a sanctuary for the soul for alcohol lovers.

en-US.title: The star of the Peking duck pairing is
en-US.description:
A place where you can enjoy Peking Duck + Hot Pot + Yanghe until 2 AM.avi

Did you all know that Mirim Yangjang in Apgujeong Rodeo is a famous Peking Duck restaurant open until 2 AM? 😘🤟🤟

You can experience the magic of pairing where the crispy skin of the Peking Duck meets the sweet grain and fruit notes of Yanghe Daqu, reducing greasiness while bringing out the distinct flavors. The clean finish of Yanghe Daqu cleanses the fattiness of the duck, making you crave another bite.

It offers unlimited corkage with no bottle limit, and you can order just half a Peking Duck for around 30,000 won, so the price isn't too burdensome. Plus, there are plenty of dishes perfect for drinking, such as mini hot pot and cilantro and cucumber salad, making it a place I truly love!!

My life changed after meeting Yanghe~~ 🎶

snippet.title: 수족관이 있는 살벌한 중식당
snippet.description:
수족관이 있는 광화문뷰 차이니즈 파인다이닝 레스토랑, 도원 S 에서의 황홀했던 저녁식사! 🐠🦞✨

홍콩이나 마카오에 있는 럭셔리 호텔 레스토랑에서 경험할만한 대형 수조에 더 플라자 호텔 도원의 내공이 담겨있는 요리들, 그리고 한국인 특유의 섬세하고 따뜻한 호스피탈리티를 경험할 수 있었던 밤이었어요

특히 거의 모든 재료를 말려 극강의 감칠맛과 깊은 국물맛을 느낄 수 있었던 원충 불도장 맛은 잊을 수 없었고…덕분에 기나긴 감기도 나은듯합니다 ㅎㅎ 이러면 안되는데 손가락까지 쪽쪽 빨게 만든 초염 활 바닷가재 튀김도 신의 한수였고, 최애 요리 소고기 양상추 쌈은 직원분이 직접 싸주셔서 더 황송했고요😍😍

#도원S #더플라자다이닝

snippet.title: 올리브오일에 오브제를 입힌 브랜드 🫒🎨🇮🇹
snippet.description:
테누타 산틸라리오는 이탈리아 와인 생산지로 유명한 아브루쪼에서 온 130년 헤리티지 올리브 오일 브랜드인데요. 신세계 백화점 강남에서 전제품을 직접 눈으로 볼 수 있고, 무료 시음에 럭키드로우 행사까지 참여할 수 있는 팝업이 열리고 있어요 

제가 올리브오일 러버인데, 이렇게 다양하고 감각적인 브랜드는 처음! 테누타 산틸라리오의 가장 큰 특징은 ’신선함‘! 올리브 재배부터 수확, 압착, 병입까지 전 과정을 자체 농장에서 직접 관리하고, 수확한 올리브는 24시간 이내로 냉압착해서 추출하는데요. 엑스트라버진 올리브오일의 기준 산도인 0.8% 보다 훨씬 낮은 0.33%라 폴리페놀도 높고, 항산화 효과도 높은 친구랍니다 

와인 좋아하시는 분들이라면 이탈리아 와인 명산지 아브루쪼 다들 한번씩 들어보셨죠? 유럽에서도 손꼽히는 청정지역이라 올리브도 맛있고, 단일 품종 뿐만 아니라 여러 올리브 품종을 블렌딩해서 쌉쌀함, 매콤함, 허브향까지 고루 갖춘 하이 밸런스 올리브 오일이랍니다.

신세계 강남점 팝업은 4월 30일까지로 무료 시음, 다양한 제품 비교와 구매 금액에 따른 증정 이벤트도 있어서 꼭 가보시길 바랄게요 💚

en-US.title: A brand that dresses olive oil in objects 🫒🎨🇮🇹
en-US.description:
Tenuta Santillario is a 130-year heritage olive oil brand from Abruzzo, a region famous for Italian wine production. A pop-up event is currently being held at Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam, where you can see all the products in person, enjoy free tastings, and even participate in a lucky draw.

As an olive oil lover, this is the first time I’ve encountered such a diverse and stylish brand! The biggest feature of Tenuta Santillario is its 'freshness'! They manage the entire process directly at their own farm, from olive cultivation to harvesting, pressing, and bottling, and cold-press the harvested olives within 24 hours. With an acidity of 0.33%—much lower than the standard 0.8% for extra virgin olive oil—it is a product rich in polyphenols and offers excellent antioxidant effects.

If you are a wine lover, you have all heard of Abruzzo, the renowned Italian wine region, right? As it is one of the most pristine regions in Europe, the olives are delicious. This is a high-balanced olive oil that features a harmonious blend of bitterness, spiciness, and herbal notes, created by blending not only single varieties but also various types.

The pop-up at Shinsegae Gangnam runs until April 30th. There are free tastings, product comparisons, and gift events based on purchase amount, so I highly recommend you visit! 💚

id.title: Sebuah merek yang membungkus minyak zaitun dalam berbagai benda 🫒🎨🇮🇹
id.description:
Tenuta Santillario adalah merek minyak zaitun warisan 130 tahun dari Abruzzo, wilayah yang terkenal dengan produksi anggur Italia. Acara pop-up saat ini sedang diadakan di Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam, di mana Anda dapat melihat semua produk secara langsung, menikmati pencicipan gratis, dan bahkan berpartisipasi dalam undian berhadiah.

Sebagai pecinta minyak zaitun, ini adalah pertama kalinya saya menemukan merek yang begitu beragam dan bergaya! Fitur terbesar Tenuta Santillario adalah 'kesegarannya'! Mereka mengelola seluruh proses langsung di pertanian mereka sendiri, mulai dari budidaya zaitun hingga panen, pengepresan, dan pembotolan, dan melakukan pengepresan dingin pada zaitun yang dipanen dalam waktu 24 jam. Dengan keasaman 0,33%—jauh lebih rendah daripada standar 0,8% untuk minyak zaitun extra virgin—ini adalah produk yang kaya akan polifenol dan menawarkan efek antioksidan yang sangat baik.

Jika Anda seorang pecinta anggur, Anda pasti pernah mendengar tentang Abruzzo, wilayah anggur Italia yang terkenal, bukan? Karena merupakan salah satu wilayah paling alami di Eropa, buah zaitunnya sangat lezat. Ini adalah minyak zaitun dengan keseimbangan tinggi yang menampilkan perpaduan harmonis antara rasa pahit, pedas, dan aroma herbal, yang diciptakan dengan mencampurkan tidak hanya satu varietas tetapi juga berbagai jenis.

Pop-up di Shinsegae Gangnam berlangsung hingga 30 April. Ada sesi mencicipi gratis, perbandingan produk, dan acara pemberian hadiah berdasarkan jumlah pembelian, jadi saya sangat merekomendasikan Anda untuk berkunjung! 💚

en-US.title: Life lessons learned at Seorijae in Bangbae-dong 🤟
en-US.description:
1. Fish must have a big loaf.

2. You must eat plenty of seasoned greens whenever you get the chance.

3. Eating rice cooked in a pot makes your body healthy.

I really love the combination of smoked Maldon salt with grilled rockfish, flounder, mackerel, and Spanish mackerel—fish that are hard to grill at home. Also, if you order a set menu or add 3,000 won, you can enjoy the self-service bar with seasonal greens to your heart's content, and the hot rice cooked in a pot is just perfect.

en-US.description:
It's me, 500-Hour Aged Sirloin 🥩✨

Originally, Changgo 43's signature style is to tear the meat off a cast-iron pan with a chisel while eating, but for this 500-hour (20.8 days...) aged sirloin, they grill it to a thickness of 3cm, sear it, rest it, and slice it right in front of you like a steak. It seems to have become much more delicious this way!!!!!!

I sincerely highly recommend the new menu item, the Seasonal Vegetable Yukhoe Bibimbap. The sauce isn't too spicy, and the combination of over 8 kinds of spring vegetables is fragrant and just wonderful 🥹👍👍

Changgo 43 also offers corkage-free service.

Hanwoo dining from lunchtime, let's go!!!

snippet.title: 급식 최초로 블루리본! 흑백요리사 솔직 후기
snippet.description:
급식에 대한 편견과 한계를 깨버린 아워홈

급식은 어린이집부터 유치원, 학교를 비롯해 휴게소, 공항, 회사, 병원, 주상복합 아파트, 실버타운 등 우리 전생애주기에 늘 있는 가까운 음식 서비스죠. 1980년대 식자재 공급을 시작으로 기업형 급식을 최초로 시작한 아워홈이 급식으로 블루리본에 도전했고, 선정되었습니다 

심사위원으로 참여했었는데, 고급 한식당에서 맛볼 수 있는 메뉴들에 놀랐고 제한된 단가 안에서 맛을 구현해낸게 신기할정도로 맛있었어요. 그 시작을 알리는 자리로 유명 셰프님과 미디어를 모시고 진행하는 행사가 있었는데 셰프님들도 맛있게 즐기시는 모습 보니 진짜 인정 받은 느낌!!

en-US.title: First Blue Ribbon Award for School Lunch! Honest Review by Black and White Chef
en-US.description:
Our Home: Breaking the Stereotypes and Limitations of School Meals

School meals are a ubiquitous food service that exists throughout our lives, from daycare centers and kindergartens to schools, rest areas, airports, companies, hospitals, apartment complexes, and retirement communities. Our Home, which began supplying food ingredients in the 1980s and pioneered the corporate food service industry, challenged itself for the Blue Ribbon Award and was selected.

I served as a judge and was amazed by the menu items available at high-end Korean restaurants. The taste was surprisingly delicious, even within a limited budget. To mark the launch, we hosted an event with renowned chefs and the media. Seeing the chefs enjoying their meals made me feel truly recognized!

Congratulations 💙

snippet.description:

en-US.title: A place where you feel better when calculating
en-US.description:
🤓🔎 This place makes you feel even better when you pay! Other places would have been around 200,000 won, but it's surprisingly cheap at almost half that.

To Find Peter is an Italian restaurant that's been expanding rapidly, and the Seongsu branch was always packed from the moment it opened until it closed.

I researched why it had such a long line, and found out that the atmosphere is perfect for a blind date, and the portions are 1.5 times more generous than other places, but at half the price. Whenever friends ask, "Is there anything delicious and reasonably priced?", I recommend it as a casual daily date spot!! Save it👍

snippet.title: 돼지고기로 6년 연속 블루리본 받은 집
snippet.description:
돼지고기로 6년 연속 블루리본 받은 곳, 다르긴 다르네요

블루리본 앰버서더가 골라주는 블루리본 맛집 💙💙
그 이름은 바로 월화고기! 

자리에 앉으니 예약자명 인쇄해서 테이블 매트 만들어주는 것부터 스트레스 없는 동물복지 농장 돼지고기만을 사용하고 
두툼한 순종 듀록 목살은 정말 쫀득 쫀득하면서 육즙이 한가득... 🤤🤤🤤

김치는 기본 모든 반찬 직접 만들고, 새콤한 대파 김치에 구워먹는 치즈까지 마무리하니까 정말 다른 곳 가기 싫던데요 ㅎㅎ 냉면 면까지 직접 제면하는 곳이니 진정성이 남다름...

⚡️TIP ⚡️ 월화고기 보라매점은 오후 4시부터 6시에 사이에 가면 30% 할인도 해주니 박포갈비랑 소맥 한잔하면서 입 좀 호강시켜주세요~

en-US.title: A house that received a Blue Ribbon for its pork for six consecutive years
en-US.description:
A place that's received a Blue Ribbon for its pork for six consecutive years—it's definitely different.

Blue Ribbon restaurants chosen by Blue Ribbon Ambassadors 💙💙
It's called Wolhwagogi!

Once seated, they printed my name on the table mat and made a stress-free meal, using only pork from farms with animal welfare.
The thick, pure-bred Duroc pork neck was incredibly chewy and juicy... 🤤🤤🤤

They make all the side dishes themselves, including kimchi, and even the sour green onion kimchi and grilled cheese. I really didn't want to go anywhere else. ㅎㅎ They even make their own naengmyeon noodles, so the authenticity is truly outstanding.

⚡️TIP ⚡️ Wolhwa Meat Boramae Branch offers a 30% discount if you go between 4 and 6 p.m., so indulge yourself with some Bakpo Galbi and some soju!

snippet.description:
Taste of Pinsa Romana 🇮🇹✨

en-US.title: Have you ever tried Roman-style square pizza?
en-US.description:
Taste of Pinsa Romana 🇮🇹✨

Following our visit to Mullae, we've now conquered Sinyongsan and Samgakjido.

Try the Roman-style pizza, Pinsa Romana, at @bop_brotherownerpizza 🍝🍕

Pinsa Romana uses a mixture of various ingredients, including soybean and rice flour, rather than just wheat flour. Thanks to a fermentation time of over 72 hours, the dough is low in gluten and crispy!

BOP has a grocery market-like atmosphere, where you can purchase alcohol, drinks, chips, olives, and more, making it incredibly convenient. They're open from 10 a.m., so why not stop by for brunch? 🌞🏟️

snippet.title: 메주같은 스페인 전통햄 발견
snippet.description:

You'd be hard-pressed to find a fine dining restaurant like this in Yeoksam-dong?
